name: Modern Motion Craft
description: Additive deterministic checks for award-site motion choreography: scroll-driven effects, animated heroes, and motion-library evidence.

ruleExtensions.instruction: The project must import a supported motion library (gsap, framer-motion, motion, motion-dom, or motion/react) and use it in at least one component; plain CSS transitions alone are insufficient for this extension.
The rendered page must show animated-hero, scroll-reveal, parallax, marquee, number-ticker, tilt, or glow effects visible at desktop width; the capture evidence must differ from a fully static page.
A prefers-reduced-motion stylesheet or media query must exist so that all choreography degrades to the static composition without motion artifacts.
Interactive states must animate: every card, button, and link that changes on hover or pointer must transition rather than snap, with duration between 100ms and 500ms.
Scroll choreography must not break mobile: no horizontal overflow, no content hidden under unpinned sections, and touch scrolling must remain smooth at the mobile breakpoint.

tierB.name: motionCraft
tierB.condition: only scored when the modern-motion extension is enabled
tierB.instruction: Score whether the motion feels choreographed and premium (GSAP/award-site quality): intentional sequencing, easing with personality, scroll effects that enhance content, and no jank, over-animation, or motion used as decoration.
